newsitem.title: USA: Dart Financial regains stake in Salomon.
newsitem.headline: Dart Financial regains stake in Salomon.

text.p: Dart Financial Corp. said Tuesday it raised its stake in Salomon Inc. to 5.2 percent, or 5,472,500 common shares, after selling much of its stake in October 1995.

Dart Financial is a private trust company affilated with Dart Container Corp., a large manufacturer of polystyrene cups and plastic cutlery and dinnerware. It is not connected with the Haft family's publicly traded Dart Group Corp.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Dart said Ross Financial Corp., one of its affiliates, holds the bulk of the stake -- 5,429,500 common shares, purchasing the shares for about $209 million.

Ross Financial began buying Salomon shares again on Oct. 30, 1995, until March 13, 1996. Dart resumed its purchases on Oct. 22, 1996, and has since then purchased 1,879,400 shares at prices ranging from $44.50 to $45 per share.
The stake is held for long-term passive investment purposes, Dart said in the filing.
Dart, which has offices in Mason, Mich., did not return phone calls seeking comment.
On Oct. 17, 1995, Dart Financial said it sold the bulk of its stake in Salomon, reducing its holding to 0.04 percent from 7.6 percent, leaving Dart and its affiliates with 43,000 common shares.
